title: Inventory and manage agents in the Microsoft 365 admin center
problem: You don't know which agents exist or who uses them.
steps: Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > Overview for a summary, then All agents > Registry for the full inventory (in tenants that don't have the new Agents section yet: Copilot > Agents).
Review each agent's publisher type (Microsoft, external partner, published by your org, shared by creator), owner, availability and risk signals.
Approve or reject requests under All agents > Requests, assign owners to ownerless agents, and block or delete agents that violate policy.
Use the AI Administrator role for day-to-day agent management instead of Global Administrator.
pitfalls: The admin experience (Microsoft Agent 365) is evolving fast — page names differ between tenants and Frontier program members.
Agents built with the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit can show up under Integrated apps rather than in the agent registry until they are published through the agent flow.
